method: Each official HUD PDF was downloaded from its hud.gov publisher URL, text-extracted, rendered page-by-page with Poppler, and visually inspected in full. The digital text layer was compared with the rendered pages; OCR was unnecessary because no text-layer dispute was found.

artifacts.title: Dear Colleague Letter on Neighborhood Crime Data and School Quality
artifacts.revisionObservation: Dated April 24, 2026; seven-page HUD Assistant Secretary Dear Colleague letter.
artifacts.reviewObservation: All seven pages are legible and complete. The HUD heading, issue date, title, numbered footnotes, legal discussion, practical examples, page numbering and Craig W. Trainor signature/title are visible without clipping or overlap.

artifacts.title: Notice of the Withdrawal of FHEO Guidance Documents
artifacts.revisionObservation: Dated September 17, 2025 and effective upon receipt; four-page FHEO withdrawal notice.
artifacts.reviewObservation: All four pages are legible and complete. The HUD/FHEO identity, date, subject, purpose, analysis, complete two-page withdrawn-guidance table and closing statement are visible without clipping or overlap.
